name: "Choose Your Own Adventure" Mashed Potato Bowls with Broccoli, Bacon, Ranch-Sour Cream & Cheddar (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!

Wash, dry, peel, and medium dice potatoes. Place in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.

Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring a boil over high heat. Once the water in the pan is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low (allowing it to simmer until ready to use).
While the water comes to a boil, wash, dry, and separate broccoli into small florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Place sour cream, milk, and ranch dressing mix in another small bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup sour cream
whole milk
1 ½ tsp dry ranch dressing mix

instructions.primary_message: Place cheese and bacon bits each in their own additional small bowls and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup cheddar cheese, shredded
½ cup bacon bits

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are almost done, return the simmering water in the pan to a full boil. Add broccoli and cook until fork-tender, 3-4 minutes. Drain and return to the bowl.

When the potatoes are done, drain and place in a large bowl. Add milk, butter, salt, and pepper, then using a potato masher, have fun mashing until smooth (take turns mashing if you have multiple helpers!).
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup whole milk
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide mashed potatoes between bowls. Serve with broccoli, ranch-sour cream, cheese, and bacon bits, allowing everyone to build their own bowl. Enjoy!
